overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the April 1 minutes did not yet exist in draft form, and the 2020 minutes were supplied promptly. Executive session and non-minutes document claims were declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Authority failed to produce meeting minutes within 10 days of his requests, including minutes of an April 1 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because minutes of the April 1 meeting did not exist in either approved or draft form, the Authority did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide minutes of that meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Authority refused to produce all executive session minutes, without identifying any specific executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to review this allegation because our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

allegations.summary: Complainant's request also sought meeting notices and other documents beyond minutes, which the AG said falls under the Public Records Law.
allegations.key_passage: Requests for other documents are subject to the Public Records Law, which imposes separate requirements for responses.
